inputs.description: Event folder name, for example beskydska-sedmicka-2026

tasks.label: optimize-event-photos
tasks.command: src='${input:photoSource}'; event='${input:eventSlug}'; dst="photos/$event"; mkdir -p "$dst"; i=1; while IFS= read -r f; do out=$(printf '%s-%02d.jpg' "$event" "$i"); sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 80 -Z 1600 "$f" --out "$dst/$out" >/dev/null; echo "$f -> $dst/$out"; i=$((i+1)); done < <(find "$src" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -iname '*.jpg' -o -iname '*.jpeg' -o -iname '*.png' -o -iname '*.webp' -o -iname '*.heic' \) | sort)
